Name: Some Building Edits - Seasonal
Author: MagnoIia
Description:
[size=6][b]Some Building Edits - Seasonal[/b]
[/size]

I converted [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3113?tab=description]Some Building Edits by TheMourningStar[/url] for Content Patcher and made it seasonal.
I have also added a couple of new buildings to go with the rest of them.


[size=3]Updates:
[/size]-  01/10/2024  - Added Alternative Textures version.

-  24/12/2024  - Added retextures for: Big Shed, Beach Cabin, Trailer Cabin, and for Stardew Valley Expanded: Premium Barn, Premium Coop, Winery.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿    Added snow overlays to match Earthy, Starblue and Vibrant Pastoral Recolor.

-  30/12/2024  - Updated Alternative Textures version.

-  27/05/2025  - Added paint masks to all of the buildings.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿    Added retexture for doghouse.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿    Fixed SVE buildings for Alternative Textures version.

- 18/01/2026  - Added retexture for Stardew Valley Expanded: Grandpa's Shed.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿  Added paint masks for Alternative Textures version.


[size=3]Buildings:[/size]
- Barn (regular, big, deluxe),
- Coop (regular, big, deluxe),
- Greenhouse,
- Farmhouse,
- Mill,
- Shed,
- Silo,
- Stable,
- Well,
- Slime Hutch* (original size),
- Junimo Hut,
- Gold Clock,
- Earth and Water Obelisk.

[size=3]Buildings that I added:[/size]
- Cabins (plank, stone, log, neighbour, rustic, beach, trailer),
- Smaller Slime Hutch for 1.6,
- Desert and Island Obelisk,
- Big Shed,
- Doghouse,
- Buildings for SVE (Premium Barn, Premium Coop, Winery, Grandpa's Shed).

* If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21488]Slime Hutch Restored[/url]﻿ my mod will automatically load the hutch in its original size


[size=3]Config options[/size]
There are four options for silo and two for shed.
If you don't want some of the buildings you can disable them in the config.



[size=3]Credits to TheMourningStar for the original buildings ♡[/size]
